item.title: DFM for Multi-Process Orders: Designing Parts That Print, Cut, and Machine Together
item.description: When a product contains 3D-printed, laser-cut, and CNC-machined components, design-for-manufacturing discipline at the interface points eliminates the most common production failures.

item.title: About Send Cut Ship
item.description:
Upload. Quote. Ship.

Send Cut Ship was built by fabricators, for engineers. The founding team — Max Davis (MAXCNC), Ben Stagl (SAIC, 20-year fabrication veteran), and Ally Reza (ChiLab Studio, Chicago) — has collectively run hundreds of production runs across additive manufacturing, laser cutting, and CNC machining. We built Send Cut Ship because we were tired of managing three separate vendors for parts that needed to arrive together.

The premise is simple: upload your CAD files, get a single instant quote across all processes, approve, and we handle the rest — production, assembly if needed, and shipment directly to your door or your contract manufacturer.

item.title: Services
item.description:
3D Printing

Send Cut Ship offers the full spectrum of additive manufacturing — from FDM functional prototypes to DMLS titanium end-use parts. Upload your STL or STEP file and receive an instant quote with DFM feedback. Materials range from PLA and PETG to Inconel 718 and Ti6Al4V. Build envelopes up to 800 × 400 × 500 mm. Tolerances ±0.1 mm standard, ±0.05 mm achievable on SLA/SLS.

Laser Cutting

Our laser cutting service handles DXF and DWG uploads for immediate pricing on flat-pattern sheet parts. Materials: mild steel, stainless 304/316, aluminum 5052/6061, acrylic, polycarbonate, plywood, MDF, and fabric. Maximum sheet size 1,500 × 3,000 mm. Bend allowance calculations included for formed parts. Anodizing, powder coating, and brushed stainless finishes available.
